description: This file defines the PipelineRunner class, responsible for managing execution of pipeline tasks including signal handling, task cancellation, cleanup, and optional garbage collection within a pipeline execution framework.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages the execution of pipeline tasks with lifecycle and signal handling, providing methods for running, stopping, canceling, and cleanup within an asynchronous environment.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, name: Optional[str] = None, handle_sigint: bool = True, handle_sigterm: bool = False, force_gc: bool = False, loop: Optional[asyncio.AbstractEventLoop] = None, )
methods.description: Initializes the PipelineRunner with optional configuration including signal handling, garbage collection, and loop setting.

methods.name: run(self, task: PipelineTask)
methods.description: Runs a provided pipeline task to completion, handling signal interruption and cleanup.

methods.name: stop_when_done(self)
methods.description: Schedules all running tasks to stop once their current processing is finished.

methods.name: _cancel(self)
methods.description: Internal method to cancel all tasks using asyncio.gather.

methods.name: _setup_sigint(self)
methods.description: Sets up handling for SIGINT signals for graceful shutdown.

methods.name: _setup_sigterm(self)
methods.description: Sets up handling for SIGTERM signals for graceful shutdown.

methods.name: _sig_handler(self)
methods.description: Handles interrupt signals by scheduling cancellation of all tasks.

methods.name: _sig_cancel(self)
methods.description: Performs task cancellation upon signal receipt.

methods.name: _gc_collect(self)
methods.description: Forces garbage collection and logs the number of objects collected and remaining.

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.signature: ( self, *, name: Optional[str] = None, handle_sigint: bool = True, handle_sigterm: bool = False, force_gc: bool = False, loop: Optional[asyncio.AbstractEventLoop] = None, )
